description: This PHP class file defines the LeaveEntitlementDao class, which manages data access operations related to employee leave entitlements in an HR management system. It includes methods for retrieving, saving, updating, deleting, and reporting on leave entitlement data, interacting with related entities such as Leave, Employee, LeaveType, and LeaveLeaveEntitlement.

classes.name: LeaveEntitlementDao
classes.description: Data access object class for managing employee leave entitlement records, including retrieval, creation, updates, deletions, and reporting related to employee leave entitlements.

methods.name: getPendingStatusIds
methods.description: Returns array of status IDs representing leave requests pending approval.

methods.name: getLeaveEntitlements
methods.description: Fetches a list of leave entitlement records based on search filter parameters.

methods.name: getLeaveEntitlementsCount
methods.description: Returns the count of leave entitlement records matching given filter parameters.

methods.name: getLeaveEntitlementsSum
methods.description: Calculates and returns the sum of 'noOfDays' for entitlement records matching filter parameters.

methods.name: getLeaveEntitlement
methods.description: Retrieves a LeaveEntitlement object by its ID.

methods.name: saveLeaveEntitlement
methods.description: Saves a LeaveEntitlement record, managing transactions, and linking leave to unused entitlement if applicable.

methods.name: getExistingLeaveEntitlementIds
methods.description: Returns a list of existing entitlement IDs from a provided list of IDs.

methods.name: getLeaveEntitlementsByIds
methods.description: Retrieves leave entitlement records for specified IDs.

methods.name: deleteLeaveEntitlements
methods.description: Marks specified leave entitlement records as deleted.

methods.name: bulkAssignLeaveEntitlements
methods.description: Assigns leave entitlements to multiple employees in a bulk operation, possibly linking leave days and handling transactional integrity.

methods.name: getValidLeaveEntitlements
methods.description: Fetches leave entitlements valid within specific date ranges and leave type, for an employee.

methods.name: getLeaveBalance
methods.description: Calculates the leave balance for an employee for a given leave type as of a specific date, including entitlements, used, scheduled, pending, and leave without entitlement.

methods.name: getEntitlementUsageForLeave
methods.description: Retrieves leave entitlement usage for a specific leave request.

methods.name: getLeaveWithoutEntitlements
methods.description: Gets leave records without associated entitlements for specified employee numbers, leave type, and date range.

methods.name: getMatchingEntitlements
methods.description: Finds leave entitlement records matching employee number and optional date range and leave type.

methods.name: getLeaveTypesForEntitlementUsageReport
methods.description: Returns leave types relevant for an entitlement usage report based on filter parameters.

methods.name: getLeaveTypesCountForEntitlementUsageReport
methods.description: Returns count of leave types for entitlement usage report, based on filters.

methods.name: getEmployeesForEntitlementUsageReport
methods.description: Returns employees relevant for an entitlement usage report based on filter parameters.

methods.name: getEmployeesCountForEntitlementUsageReport
methods.description: Returns count of employees for entitlement usage report based on filters.

methods.name: getLeaveTypeIdsForEntitlementsByEmployee
methods.description: Returns leave type IDs associated with an employee's entitlements within optional date ranges.
